title: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Clears Censor Board, Locks 165-Minute Runtime Ahead of Release
excerpt: The Central Board of Film Certification has awarded the Nelson Dilipkumar sequel a U/A 16+ rating. The film releases in theatres worldwide on October 15, 2026.
body:
• Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has been certified U/A 16+ by the Central Board of Film Certification, clearing the final pre-release hurdle ahead of its worldwide theatrical release on October 15, 2026.
  • The CBFC listing locks the runtime at 165 minutes and 18 seconds — about two hours and 45 minutes, slightly shorter than the first film's roughly 168 minutes.
  • The sequel brings back Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar and adds SJ Suryah, Vidya Balan, Mithun Chakraborty, Vijay Sethupathi and Suraj Venjaramoodu to the ensemble.
  • The film arrives in theatres worldwide on October 15, 2026, including in IMAX formats; India's U/A 16+ rating means parental guidance is advised for viewers under 16.

Nelson Dilipkumar's Jailer 2, starring Rajinikanth, has completed the censorship process, with the Central Board of Film Certification awarding the film a U/A 16+ rating and locking its runtime at 165 minutes and 18 seconds. The certification details were updated on the CBFC's official website on Tuesday, a day after producer Sun Pictures released the film's trailer — setting the stage for its worldwide theatrical release on October 15.

Context & Background

"https://youtube.com/watch?v=FW_PPcr1sPE Context & Background A sequel to 2023's Jailer , the film brings Rajinikanth back as Muthuvel Pandian, the retired jailer nicknamed Tiger."

A sequel to 2023's Jailer, the film brings Rajinikanth back as Muthuvel Pandian, the retired jailer nicknamed Tiger. The first film, also directed by Nelson, was among the biggest Tamil blockbusters of 2023, and expectations for the follow-up have run high since the sequel was announced. Nelson returns as writer and director, with Kalanithi Maran producing under the Sun Pictures banner.

The technical team stays intact from the first film: Anirudh Ravichander composes the music, Vijay Kartik Kannan handles the cinematography, R. Nirmal edits, and Drk. Kiran is credited with production design.

Impact & Analysis

The U/A 16+ certificate positions the film as mature commercial action fare — consistent with the darker, harder-edged world built around Muthuvel Pandian. The sequel expands the franchise's ensemble considerably. Alongside returning cast members Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, Vinayakan and Jaffer Sadiq, the trailer has confirmed the return of Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar from the first film.

The new additions include SJ Suryah, Vidya Balan, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Mithun Chakraborty, Vijay Sethupathi, Apeksha Porwal — who makes her Tamil debut — Anna Rajan, Hakkim Shah, Bagavathi Perumal, Meghana Raj, Shamna Kasim and Jatin Sarna. Trade site TeluguCinema further reports that Hrithik Roshan appears in a guest role with a substantial episode — which, if borne out, would make the cast a genuine pan-Indian lineup spanning Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi and Telugu cinema. The film will also release in IMAX formats, a significant theatrical expansion for the franchise.

Diaspora Angle

Rajinikanth's overseas pull makes the October 15 date one for the diaspora calendar — the Tamil diaspora in the United States, the Gulf and Southeast Asia has historically turned his releases into opening-weekend events. A worldwide day-and-date release, including on IMAX screens, means overseas fans get the same theatrical window as Chennai, and advance bookings abroad are expected to open alongside domestic sales in the coming days.

What's Next / Looking Ahead

With certification done, the film enters its final promotional stretch. Variety India reports the campaign is skipping the traditional grand audio launch in favour of a three-hour television special with Rajinikanth ahead of release — a move timed to the Dussehra-period window. The trailer's reception and day-one box office numbers will be the next measures of whether the sequel can match its predecessor.
